decision.explanation: Both 'Medal of Francysk Skaryna' (from D1) and 'Knight of the Order of the White Rose of Finland' (from D2) are explicitly stated in the source documents as awards received by Manuel Estrada Pérez. The instruction to preserve distinct valid referents and complementary answers requires retaining both, as they represent separate positive assertions from independent sources regarding the same subject.
